scene_context.visual_style: Cinematic film footage with moody lighting and special effects.
people: Man in black leather jacket standing on a bridge., gesturing with both hands while talking.

cues.en: Glowing industrial pipes fill the frame before pulling back to reveal a sprawling city of smokestacks and a canal bridge.
The word SIMULATION appears behind two workers as a brain-shaped object rotates inside purple energy rings.
The title TEARS OF STEEL fades in on black, then an airship hovers over the smoking industrial city.
A newspaper headline reads ROBOTICIST KILLER ROBOTS. A shooter in a dark jacket aims a scoped rifle from a rooftop railing.
Through the scope the massive airship drifts over red-roofed buildings.
The shooter in a dark jacket lies prone on the roof. An older person with white hair rests nearby.
Bright muzzle flashes erupt along the airship hull as it banks lower over the city.
